headline: StepFun's step-5-preview sets an all-time token share record at 13.1%, now two days running
summary: StepFun's step-5-preview is still holding its all-time record at 13.1% of tokens, day 2 of the streak. StepFun's provider share rose 3.4% in a single day, pushing it into second place behind DeepSeek.
highlights: DeepSeek still holds the top provider spot at 25.7%, and DeepSeek and StepFun together hold 38.8%.
Top three providers (DeepSeek, StepFun, Zhipu AI) hold 48.1% between them.
inclusionai/ling-3.1-flash climbed 11 places in a day to rank 32.
Qwen's qwen3.8-27b-20260814 and Google's gemma-4-26b-a4b-it-20260403 are the new arrivals, at ranks 49 and 51.
Google's gemini-3.7-flash and Anthropic's claude-4.6-sonnet dropped off the board, last seen at ranks 47 and 50.
